purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for delegations, scopes, chains, remote effective authority, expiry and revocation propagation.

topics.name: Delegation and Remote Authority Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for delegations, scopes, chains, remote effective authority, expiry and revocation propagation.

semantics.identity_rule: Identity, delegation, chain segment, session and authorization-decision identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: grant/revoke/redelegate operations invoke separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing delegation grants no delegated authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Delegation-chain edges correspond only to explicit parent refs.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.

hard_gates.condition: local rights shown as remote rights

references.purpose: Monitor exposes effective bounded remote authority.
